lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six vertical columns of high-intensity white blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. These circular clusters are arranged in a regular grid, with the most defined centroids occurring along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint but visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs, creating a rectilinear lattice where the blobs occupy the center of the grid nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow region directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, located in the lower-left foreground, displays a high density of smaller, non-ordered high-luminance spots that differ in scale and spatial distribution from the larger lateral flank blobs.
